description: Total inverter loss from the phenomenological fitted law L = k1|i| + k2 i^2 + k3|w| + k4|i w| + k5*vdc*|i| (v2 coefficients, calibrated against 7 recorded campaigns 2026-10-20). Splits into plate share for the thermal plant; carries the energy-balance term p_link_drawn the DcBus needs. Domain-guarded at zero (data-law span guard).

inputPorts.name: Idle
inputPorts.description: >= 0.5 disables losses (gates off); 0 = live (zero-bound default when unconnected).

outputPorts.name: P_Loss
outputPorts.description: Total inverter loss (machine winding + devices + speed/friction + bench residual), W.

outputPorts.name: P_Plate
outputPorts.description: Plate share of the loss heating the baseplate NTC, W.

PlateShare.description: Fraction of total loss heating the baseplate (rest: machine winding/friction/bench).

IdleHeat_W.description: Heat floor into the plate while gates are live (bench aux/idle residual, cal_log idle-warm +4.9K anchor = 120 W); 0 when Idle >= 0.5.
